rationale: The installer's primary URL at releases.astral.sh returns 404 for 0.11.9 and the installer falls back to an alternate URL and succeeds. The reporter attributes this to Astral's release mirror/CDN, which is Astral infrastructure rather than a third party, so it is not external. It is a release/distribution defect that maintainers can check without a reproduction, so it is a bug, probably a transient publishing or mirror-sync problem. Two issue searches found no duplicates; the only hit, #5605, is a generic docs feedback tracker and unrelated.
